We pull in your health data and fuse it into one secure model. You get daily text updates on what changed, what it means, and what to do next; conversational health Q&A like "What should I do to improve my bloodwork?"; cross-data trend detection that catches patterns individual platforms miss; and a full platform to dig deeper, explore your health data, and text your Illume agent anytime. We're 3 MIT grads & friends, with experience at Windsurf, MIT CSAIL, Eli Lilly, & the Broad Institute.

name: Most Robotic
one_liner: Research lab for physical AI
long_description:
We're a robotics research lab pushing what's possible with physical AI.

We're MIT computer scientists & friends since middle school, with robotics research backgrounds and industry experience at NASA JPL, SpaceX, and AWS.

Email founders@mostrobotic.com to learn more.

name: Osmaura
one_liner: AI growth engine for law firms.
long_description:
Our agents scan the web to deliver new client & cross-selling opportunities for law firm partners.

Every day, our customers log onto our platform to see who to contact, why now, and what to say.

Partners are trained to practice law - not to prospect, sell, and manage pipelines. We're here to help them grow while they focus on what they do best.

name: Palette
one_liner: An AI-Native Media Platform
long_description: Palette is a self-improving AI-native media platform built by MIT computer scientists and multimodal researchers that unifies the creative workflow into a single generation engine. We eliminate tool and context fragmentation for creative and marketing teams in enterprises and allow content creators to transform static assets into controllable, repeatable, and self-improving workflows in order to autonomously improve quality and revenue growth.

name: Marker
one_liner: Platform and FDEs for rebuilding businesses agent-first
long_description: Marker embeds with companies, learns how their organization actually works, and ships custom AI agents into production in weeks via the Marker Command Center. Each agent deepens our understanding, so the next one launches faster until the whole org is agent-first.

name: WonderTx
one_liner: Extrapolative AI to unlock First-in-Class drugs
long_description:
We’re an AI-native biotech, working on replacing needles with pills. Many drugs, like insulin or Ozempic, are wonderful except you have to inject them. We discover new molecules that you can take as a pill instead. Because the pills operate on biology which has been shown to be effective in people, rather than merely in animal models of disease, we avoid what has historically been the single biggest risk in drug discovery.  This should dramatically increase our probability of success.

There’s $200B of treatable diseases and validated human biology without a pill because discovery programs lack a tractable chemical starting point. This is a zero-shot inference problem, because these targets have no training data, so LLMs and other historical interpolative AI approaches are insufficient. Instead, we are building our own extrapolative frontier models that reason beyond their training data. Most critically, we have repeatedly validated our platform on both our own and partner programs. On 4 biologically- and structurally-diverse targets where we had zero training data, we successfully picked binders that were validated experimentally, with confirmation ranging from primary screen hits to crystallographic structures.

name: Sidekick
one_liner: AI agent that handles frontline operations over text
long_description:
Sidekick is an AI agent that runs frontline operations over text. Workers text problems, photos, or voice memos in any language; it answers from the company's own documents, creates and routes the work order, and syncs with the software the company already runs. No app, no login, works on any phone.

It watches connected machine data and texts the right worker when something's drifting wrong, before it becomes downtime. And it compounds: every answer becomes a searchable knowledge base the company owns, so tribal knowledge stops walking out the door when veterans retire.

name: Mentlio
one_liner: Engineering Intelligence and Token Optimization for the AI-Coding Era
long_description: Mentlio an applied research lab focused on optimizing AI ROI for the modern enterprise. We help engineering teams draw a line between their AI spend and delivery, per engineer. We then cut ~30% of AI spend via Mentlio's custom ML-based intelligent routing, context optimization, and prompt compression.

name: Atlas Discovery
one_liner: Predicting human response to drugs in clinical trials

name: Trident
one_liner: Autonomous offensive security agents. The best defense is offense
long_description:
Trident is the standard for modern day security. its an agentic pentester that chains vulnerabilities together like a real attacker mapping verified attack paths across AWS, Azure, GCP, web apps, and APIs. Run AI attacks and get fixes.

Get started today: tridentsecurity.io

name: rekursiv.ai
one_liner: Scale AI scientists whose own breakthroughs accelerate the next.
long_description:
We're scaling self-improving AI scientist teams to ideate/experiment/discover, generating new knowledge autonomously. Their discoveries reduced ARC-1/2 costs by 10,000× while maintaining state-of-the-art accuracy and yielded material advances on combinatorial ML problems.

We believe that AI is bounded not by compute, but ideas. Scaling to millions of sessions of discovery enables leveraging its own discoveries and presents a novel training source capable of ushering a new era of self-reliant foundational models.

name: Amorphic Labs
one_liner: OpenRouter for Agent Capabilities
long_description: The next billion software users are AI agents, yet agents still can't act on their own: every paid tool they need runs through a human making accounts, managing API keys, and guessing which provider is best. We are the capability marketplace built for agents: one MCP and one balance through which agents find, pay for, and use APIs, data, skills, other agents, and software at runtime, with every request routed to the best provider based on benchmarks from real tasks and outcome feedback from the agents themselves.

name: Proprio Robotics
one_liner: Building autonomous data centers
long_description: Proprio Robotics is building state-of-the-art physical intelligence to automate the entire data center lifecycle—from buildout to maintenance to decommissioning. There are currently 400,000 unstaffed data center technicians positions in the United States alone, which means the massive compute needs of AI are being bottlenecked by labor constraints. Proprio is solving this by building robots that do it instead, and is deploying data center maintenance robots starting Q1 2027.

name: Rindler
one_liner: The IDE for Tokenmaxxers
long_description:
We build Maxxwell, a desktop app for people who run several coding agents at once.

Past two or three sessions, you become the bottleneck. Every session asks you something, most of it small, and you spend the day answering instead of deciding. It is also hard to tell which sessions are making progress, which are stuck on something trivial, and which have quietly started building the wrong thing.

Maxxwell puts every session in one window and marks each one working, idle, or waiting on you. On top of that sits an orchestrator, a real coding-agent session of its own that reads the others and reports back. You talk to it instead of to twelve terminals. It tells you what landed, what it decided for you, and what actually needs your call.

Every worker is your own tool, unmodified. Claude Code, Codex and Cursor Agent run in real terminal sessions you can attach to and take over at any point

name: Edgerun
one_liner: Military exoskeletons
long_description: Edgerun Industries builds military exoskeletons. Our hip-mounted system assists every step a soldier takes under combat load, so they can travel farther, carry more, and arrive ready to fight.

name: GitCafe
one_liner: The Git forge for the next hundred billion commits
long_description: We build GitHub for agents. We're rebuilding the infrastructure for the next hundred billion commits and CI jobs with hundreds of engineers already making the move.

name: Kebra
one_liner: Making the field queryable
long_description:
Kebra makes the field queryable.

We capture what happens across jobs, sites, and assets and turn it into a live operating memory that AI can query and act on. Our AI employees use that context to automate the work that follows across the systems companies already use.

Every job makes that memory richer, building the company specific context software agents use today and physical agents will need tomorrow.

name: Torus
one_liner: Legora for physical engineering firms
long_description:
Torus lets engineering firms and project owners build infrastructure 10x faster to reindustrialize America and the West. 

We're working with multiple Fortune 500 companies to build critical infrastructure including data centers and critical energy installations.

name: tash
one_liner: The investment platform for sports & trading cards
long_description:
tash is building the investment platform for sports and trading cards. We create professionally constructed portfolios of iconic, investment-grade cards, giving investors exposure to the asset class without the hassle of selecting, buying, storing, and selling individual cards.

Trading card investing remains fragmented, opaque, and difficult to access. tash is building the infrastructure to make the asset class simpler, more transparent, and professionally managed. We are currently pursuing SEC qualification to launch regulated investment offerings backed by trading cards.

name: Pango
one_liner: Agentic OS for e-commerce operations
long_description: Autonomous digital employee that runs back-office operations for e-commerce companies: deliveries, tracking, returns, transport and CS.

name: Hoplite
one_liner: Effortlessly deploy cloud software factories.

name: OpenTrade
one_liner: The new interface for investing.
long_description: OpenTrade is rebuilding the trading experience for a generation raised on games, social products, and AI.

name: Donkey
one_liner: The AI-native trading company: factory prices, delivered, one number
long_description:
Donkey is the modern trading company. We buy straight from Chinese factories and sell delivered to US importers: one USD price to their dock, duty paid, our own inspectors on the factory floor before the factory gets paid.

Most importers buy through trading companies that mark up every container 15 to 30 percent and never reveal the factory. US customs records are public. Almost nobody reads them, so we arrive already knowing their supply lane. They send one photo of a part they reorder. We name the factory that actually makes it and beat their landed cost in 72 hours, or they keep their supplier.

We take title, run the inspection, move the money, and offer credit-insured net-45 terms to qualified buyers. The old trading giants ran this coordination with tens of thousands of people. Our machine runs it with a handful, and every settled order compounds the pricing and reliability data the next one runs on.

Team in SF and China, English and Mandarin. Know a US importer buying from China? Send them our way: one photo of a part, and we will name their factory. donkey.trade

name: HERA
one_liner: We make sure every factory in the world builds without mistakes.
long_description: At Hera, we build tools that help heavy engineering teams bring products to market up to 20× faster. Today, we work with manufacturers of data center ancillary equipment, renewable energy systems, robotics, heat exchangers, power plants and pressure vessels.

name: Erinys
one_liner: We help lawyers start and scale AI-native law firms.
long_description: Erinys provides the technology, intake, back office, and client acquisition needed to launch and scale an AI-native law firm. Lawyers own their firms and make every legal decision; Erinys handles everything around them.

name: Perceptron ML
one_liner: We make law firms AI-native.
long_description: We build AI systems for law firms, trained on each firm's own matters and deployed privately in their environment: timekeeping, intake and matter monitoring, research, discovery, and drafting. Our grounding engine verifies every fact against a primary source before a model can cite it, which is why firms trust us with work that off-the-shelf legal AI keeps getting wrong.

name: Mass Magnetics
one_liner: USA-made magnetics for robotics and defense.
long_description:
Mass Magnetics turns recycled rare-earth scrap into high-performance permanent magnets, made in America. The materials we supply are the backbone of electric motors, sensors, speakers, hard drives, and electronics.
Our process enables DFARS-compliant magnets for defense, aerospace, and industrial manufacturers who demand domestic supply without compromising on quality.
Operations in Greater Boston, MA (Greentown Labs) and Columbus, IN.

name: Egoist Machines
one_liner: Your personal context, securely portable across every AI app.
long_description:
Egoist Machines is building the user-owned context layer that will be the unlock for the next generation of consumer AI applications. Our product, AI Passport, lets people carry the personal context they generate in everyday apps into any new product, so it understands them from the first interaction. Tell ChatGPT something and Claude already knows, for example, without any app ever owning your data.

The bottleneck for consumer AI is shifting from the model to context. Models can already handle most everyday tasks for the average user, but every new app starts cold, forcing users to re-explain themselves and forcing businesses to rebuild profiles of data that already exist.

Apps integrate with a "Sign in with AI Passport" button, then request specific information for a stated purpose and duration. Users stay in control of what moves between products and can revoke access later, which matters most for sensitive health and financial context. Under the hood, AI Passport runs on our own vector database built for fast, compact per-user memory with cryptographically enforced access control.

We're building first-party apps that give people a reason to create their Passport today, while integrating it into consumer products with existing audiences of billions.

Our North Star: your context living on your own device, sovereign to you, with every model, app, and agent coming to you.

name: Olam Labs
one_liner: Building multi-agent simulations for model evals and training.
long_description:
Multi-agent environments let us evaluate and train models in complex, simulated worlds. We work with researchers on both evaluations and training for character and agentic performance typically difficult to assess for using current popular datasets. 

Play one of our first releases, Multi-Agent Arena (https://olamlabs.ai/arena), where humans come play social strategy games against multiple AI agents. It's currently top 50 on OpenRouter and has thousands of matches played each day. We use Multi-Agent Arena to build datasets on agentic performance and real-world socialization.

name: Shielded
one_liner: The agentic origination desk for supply chain risk.
long_description: Shielded connects companies’ internal and external data to map market shifts, tariffs, and disruptions directly to suppliers, products, and margins. We turn those impacts into real-time decisions that grow and protect the business.

name: Belvedir
one_liner: The easiest way to make private AI models
long_description:
Private AI models are going to win. Belvedir is the infrastructure needed to make trillions of them.

Belvedir makes it cheap and easy for anyone to make private AI. Connect us to your agent traces through our SDK and we autonomously train custom models + harnesses + routers, privately deploy them, and recursively improve them as they are used. Our customers have seen up to 10x reductions in inference costs and 2x increases on benchmark scores.

name: Parasma
one_liner: Training human brain cells for AI compute
long_description: We write the algorithms to turn brain cells into compute.

name: Trope
one_liner: AI FDE that deploys custom AI agents into ERPs
long_description: Trope deploys custom AI agents into ERPs for mid-market companies. Every ERP is heavily customized, so useful agents need custom deployment too. Trope’s AI FDE learns each business and ERP, then builds and deploys agents, turning the last mile from services into software.

name: Palisade
one_liner: AI sales agents that run your marketplace
long_description: Palisade spins up a personal sales agent for every single visitor to your website. Marketplaces like trading card platforms, vintage stores, and short-term rental operators sell more when each customer works with a personal agent that remembers them.

name: Kara
one_liner: Making Diamond Engineerable
long_description:
Kara is building diamond semiconductors. 

We begin with growing ultra-high purity diamond wafers for advanced hardware. Used in data centers, spacecrafts, RF systems, and quantum hardware, our diamond moves heat up to 5× better than copper, helping critical systems run cooler, faster, and more reliably. 

Diamond has spent centuries as a symbol. We are turning it into infrastructure.

name: Nebula Security
one_liner: Autonomous AI defense system for cyber attack
long_description:
Nebula Security is founded by the world’s #1 hacking team.

We were the first team to build an nginx RCE and the first to root Android 17. Our co-founders include members of the world’s No. 1 CTF team, DEF CON winners, Black Hat speakers, and PhD in cybersecurity. We have won $400K in bug bounties by exploiting the Linux kernel and Chrome browser.

“Audited by Nebula Security” is a mark of serious security credibility: a signal to customers, investors, and partners that your product has been reviewed by the world’s best hackers.

name: Zomma
one_liner: Computer Use Agents for back offices in finance
long_description: Zomma builds Computer Use Agents that do the repetitive screen work in finance: logging into portals, pulling reports, reconciling books, and filling forms across systems that will never get an API. Our agents use the same screens your ops team uses today, so there is no integration project. Every action stops for human approval before anything submits. Hedge funds, asset managers, and fintech firms use Zomma for reconciliation, client onboarding, KYC, and investor reporting: the work that was never automatable until now.

name: Rex
one_liner: AI-native BPO for enterprise order-to-cash
long_description:
Rex is an AI-native service for order to cash. Rex replace manual operations with AI agents that continuously manage invoices, customers and exceptions.

Order to cash is a $60B outsourced function because the work is too messy for traditional automation. Every customer has different context, exceptions do not follow clean rules, and the next step is often buried in emails, portals, handoffs, or someone’s memory. Rex agents run continuously in the background and resolve work to SLA standards so cash keeps moving. We're live with pre-IPO tech companies, managing  >$500m in receivables from F100 companies, cutting manual follow-up cycles from weeks to hours.

We founded Rex after spending four years building Sequence, an a16z-backed finance ops platform, from zero to Series A — where we saw firsthand that at-scale, O2C still runs on manual labour.

Rex is the #1 winner of the Vercel AI Accelerator out of 2,500 teams, selected by Guillermo Rauch and leaders from OpenAI, Anthropic, Browserbase and more.

name: Enact
one_liner: Real-world RL environments for robotics models
long_description: Enact creates the physical environments to benchmark and hill climb robotics models on high-value tasks. We find where robots fail, and fix them with our in-house training loop.

name: Maingen
one_liner: Simulating Agents Running Industrial Companies
long_description: Maingen builds simulations for industrial operations ($5 trillion slice of the US economy) so frontier labs can train models that actually run power plants, factories, and datacenters.

name: Bernard
one_liner: AI employees that run home appliance repair companies
long_description:
Bernard builds AI employees for home and commercial appliance servicers. They work across phone, text, email, warranty feeds, and existing systems to manage customer communication, scheduling, and dispatch, carrying each job through diagnosis, parts preparation, technician handoff, and follow-up. At the center is Pre-ID, which combines the exact appliance and its symptoms with repair history, similar completed visits, manufacturer guidance, and parts data to produce a diagnosis, ranked parts, and follow-up questions. Technicians arrive prepared with the right parts, helping servicers complete more repairs on the first visit.

We’re building the world’s most efficient appliance servicers, creating happier customers and a more connected appliance ecosystem.

Learn more at https://bernardhq.com/

name: Studio
one_liner: Accurately simulate market response at scale
long_description: Studio is a simulation lab studying how humans and societies respond to new ideas, and is building the first software models that can accurately predict that response. Instead of creating digital twins of survey respondents, Studio builds live market models of interconnected audience segments from real, traceable consumer-behavior data. Our simulations match live KPI outcomes like revenue and purchase behavior with over 97% accuracy for consumer-facing enterprises, higher than any synthetic panel, simulation lab, or traditional market research.

name: Prized
one_liner: A cloud devbox that feels local
long_description:
Prized is a cloud development environment that feels local on your Mac. 

Developers get a dedicated, persistent machine with their repos, dependencies, and tools already configured. 

Files sync into a real local folder, remote ports appear on localhost, and terminals persist through tmux, so developers and coding agents can keep working even after the laptop closes. 

Machines can be resized or cloned as workloads grow, without rebuilding the development environment.

name: Understudy Labs
one_liner: Self-optimizing neocloud that cuts LLM bills by 80%
long_description:
Understudy is an inference cloud. We capture your AI work traces, train smaller models, and automatically deploy them (only when they outperform the expensive model you are currently paying for).

Instead of renting the same frontier model forever, your AI infrastructure gets faster, smarter, and cheaper every time it runs.

Suppose your product uses Claude for a repetitive legal workflow.

Understudy observes successful production runs, learns the specific tools and judgment required for that workflow, and trains a specialized open-weight model.

Once that model matches or beats Claude on a held-out evaluation, Understudy starts routing production traffic to it.

As more work is completed, the model keeps improving.

We started Understudy because we believe every company using AI should be accumulating intelligence, not accumulating API bills.

name: Synapse Semiconductor
one_liner: New semiconductors that merge compute and vision
long_description:
We want to push machines to where humans cant go. 
Presidential early career award winning Duke Semiconductor ECE Faculty Tania Roy and Sanjeev Chauhan are building a frontier semiconductor research lab. Their focus is on solving physical AI challenges from the semiconductor device level and building products around the moat of impossible to copy innovation. Their first work is on a new vision sensor that can run neural network filters right in the camera pixels and only collect data that machines care about. As physical AI develops, machines needs to understand the world around them if they aim to interact with them.

name: Speko
one_liner: OpenRouter for Voice
long_description: Speko is a router for voice models: one API key, and your voice agent runs on the speech-to-text, LLM, and text-to-speech models we measured as best for your language and use case. The measurements are public at benchmarks.speko.ai: we test new models the day they ship and re-route when the numbers change, so you rewrite nothing. We ran this bake-off by hand for four years at Hupo, shipping production voice for Morgan Stanley, Prudential, HSBC, and Grab.

name: Gutgutgoose
one_liner: We sequence your gut and build the probiotics it’s missing
long_description:
Most data companies pay for their data. Ours pays for itself.
Customers send us a stool sample. We sequence it, build a metabolic model of that gut, and simulate whether each probiotic strain has an open niche it can colonize. We formulate the best candidates, then re-sequence 90 days later to see what actually took hold and what changed. Each cycle gives us the baseline gut, the intervention, and the outcome. At scale, the endgame is models that predict chronic disease years before symptoms.

name: LemonLime
one_liner: Fully automated GTM for small business
long_description:
LemonLime runs fully automated sales and marketing for small businesses.

Every morning, LemonLime finds you new leads and drafts personalized outreach, prepares branded content, and identifies untapped sales & marketing opportunities.

All you have to do is click send.

name: Jcode
one_liner: The harness company
long_description: An agent is LLM + harness: We work purely on that second component. We do research to produce the most capable harness for coding, and we also make an open source, terminal based, coding agent product with 18k github stars.

name: Insurf
one_liner: The AI-Native Decision Layer for Health Insurance
long_description: Insurf is the AI-native data and decision layer for health insurance. Our model Surely identifies the lowest-cost coverage for anyone, saving individuals, families, and companies thousands per employee. Our product Inveto collects the data from hospitals and clinics that informs Surely.

name: IMPACT Drones
one_liner: Air Defense as a Service for Civilian Infrastructure.
long_description: IMPACT builds autonomous interceptor drones that ship in sealed containers. The box sits at the site it protects, data centers, power grids, airports, bases, with no crew on the pad. When sensors cue a hostile drone, an interceptor pierces its own frangible lid, launches, and rams the target, guided by onboard vision that keeps working when GPS is jammed. Legacy effectors cost $1M+ per shot against $30k threats; ours cost less than the threat and scale with the swarm, the same class of interceptor already downing Shahed drones over Ukraine. Sites subscribe to protection instead of buying missiles, hardware, reloads and monitoring included: Air Defense as a Service. 180M+ USD in signed letters of intent.

name: Verdant
one_liner: AI-native planning & permitting software for local gov
long_description:
Verdant is building the AI infrastructure for local government, and we’re starting with modern planning & permitting software.

We help governments write developer-friendly laws, then review permit applications under those rules to build faster.

name: Instaplay
one_liner: AI-Native Social Platform, Starting with Games
long_description: Over 25k creators and 100k players are on Instaplay, playing and making games. We work with the leading frontier labs to improve their game generation and coding capabilities.

name: Lyon
one_liner: Foundation models on enterprise transaction data.
long_description: Lyon builds private foundation models for banks, insurance companies, and fintechs. Each model learns from the company’s proprietary transactions, payments, clicks, and customer interactions to predict credit, fraud, collections, income, churn, and lifetime value; and runs inside the company’s cloud, so its data and intelligence remain under its control. Lyon is already working with a major insurer and trained a model on 28B transactions for a fintech serving tens of millions of active users, identifying premium-card converters 4x more precisely than its existing rules; the model is now being deployed for credit.

name: Rise Reforming
one_liner: We turn waste gases into valuable supply-secure chemicals
long_description:
Geopolitical conflicts and natural disasters frequently expose the vulnerability of the American chemical industry. The reason? Production is centralized and fossil fuel-dependent. The solution? Localized production using an undervalued resource: biogas. The US produces enough biogas to make over $20 bn/y worth of chemicals, but 60% is wasted in low-margin applications or flared altogether.

Rise Reforming is commercializing a modular process to transform this underutilized biogas on-site into cheap, supply-secure chemicals. Our beachhead market is dimethyl ether (DME), used as an aerosol propellant and a low-carbon fuel additive in propane. Our target market is methanol: an established billion $ chemical and the future of low-carbon shipping.

We're doing our pilot project at a Chicagoland wastewater plant. This will be the first wastewater biogas-to-methanol demo in the Americas.

We're hiring for a senior chemical process engineer. Apply here: https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/rise-reforming/jobs/wJ9Q9nv-senior-chemical-process-engineer

name: Floracene
one_liner: Vibecode + deploy HIPAA-compliant internal tools, no eng team needed
long_description:
Floracene lets any healthcare operator describe the internal tool they need and deploy it in one click - connected to production data, with read and write access scoped by the user. Think Lovable or Retool, except purpose-built for the needs of healthcare business that has no engineering team.

The bottleneck in healthcare isn't building anymore. Anyone can vibecode an 80% solution in an afternoon, custom to their own workflow, with people already on staff. The tool then dies locally on the builder’s computer, because IT (correctly) won't let anyone deploy a tool touching PHI without first-class authentication and permissioning. Our first design partner had multiple employees who had each built useful tools and dashboards locally, but couldn’t actually share these with coworkers or connect to their core practice data. Within weeks of implementing Floracene, they were able to consolidate their BI tooling into Floracene and shipped 4 net-new to production.

A staggering ~$200B is spent on administrative software in healthcare every year in the US. Tens of thousands of those companies still run core operations on spreadsheets, and we're at the top of the first inning of AI adoption.

Asaph and Jonah met on the hospitals team at Palantir two years ago, and have each spent the last four years in the plumbing of US healthcare: claims, eligibility, and payor contracting. Asaph was an early PM at Garner. Jonah was a founding engineer at Metriport (YC S22) after starting his own fax-automation startup for fertility clinics.

name: GUILD
one_liner: AI-Native Defense Contractor
long_description: GUILD is an AI-Native Defense contractor making aerospace parts faster and cheaper. We win defense contracts, automate manufacturing, and deliver to the government's door.

name: RealPact
one_liner: AI-native OS for Real Estate Brokerages
long_description:
RealPact builds AI agents that handle the paperwork behind real estate transactions. They find property records like deeds, tax records, permits, parcel data, and MLS information, then use that data to fill out contracts, organize documents, track deadlines, and help brokerages close deals faster.

We are starting by automating transactions and will expand into other parts of brokerage operations. Much of the software used across the real estate industry is outdated. With today’s advances in AI, we can build agents that handle this operational work and create modern software around how brokerages actually work.

We currently sell to brokerages in New Hampshire and are expanding quickly.
subindustry: Real Estate and Construction -> Housing and Real Estate

name: Buildbox
one_liner: Agent analytics for real user outcomes
long_description: Buildbox helps product teams improve the human-agent experience. We analyze user intent, agent behavior, and outcomes to find where users get stuck or lose trust, then turn those findings into ranked, reproducible issues.

name: Riften
one_liner: Earned intelligence for every company
long_description:
Intelligence will be the most valuable asset a company owns. Today, almost every company rents it.

Companies pay a handful of labs one token at a time. Each dollar buys an answer, not an asset. They spend more, but own nothing more.

Riften reverses that.

Change one environment variable and Riften becomes the gateway for a company's AI traffic. We route each request to the lowest-cost model that can do the job, serving most work on open-weight models we host. Customers save money immediately without rebuilding their products.

The gateway is the entry point. Over time, Riften turns the company's work into private models built on open weights and shaped around the business. What begins as cheaper inference becomes an intelligence stack the company owns, runs on infrastructure it controls, and uses to power its most important applications.

We call this earned intelligence. It is created by the company's own work, controlled by the company, and accumulated over time.

The next generation of companies will not rent their intelligence. They will earn it, own it, and compound it. Riften is how they get there.

name: Bizmark
one_liner: The OS for companies that make, move, or sell physical goods
long_description:
Bizmark is the operating system for companies that make, move, or sell physical goods.

Legacy ERPs force operators into templates that don’t reflect how the business runs. As a result, decisions that directly affect revenue, margins, and service levels are made from spreadsheets, with less information than the company has, often by whoever is closest, not whoever knows best.

Bizmark solves this by connecting to the systems, inboxes, spreadsheets, documents, and the knowledge that lives in people’s heads, then turning that context into optimized decisions and automated workflows. Bizmark adapts to how each company operates, not the other way around. And customers get a working product in weeks, not years.

Some of the most innovative American companies use Bizmark to transform their operations.

name: Mosaic
one_liner: Defining the frontier of multiplayer AI.
long_description:
Mosaic gives teams and their coding agents shared memory across every session, so everyone can understand what happened, why decisions were made, and pick up where someone else left off.

We started as a real-time coding environment where multiple people and their agents can work together live. It went viral, defined the multiplayer AI category, and inspired frontier labs like Anthropic.

Together, we’re building the infrastructure for people and agents to share context and work together.

name: Dialogus
one_liner: The AI-native contact center.
long_description:
Dialogus builds voice agent infrastructure for enterprises.

Most companies can demo an AI voice agent, but getting one into production is hard. Enterprise agents need to connect to phone systems, internal tools, databases, CRMs, messaging channels, human escalation flows, monitoring, and compliance processes.

Dialogus provides the infrastructure to deploy production-grade voice agents that don’t just talk but complete real workflows. Our platform lets enterprises launch agents that collect information, validate it against internal systems, update records, send follow-up messages, and escalate edge cases to humans.

name: Alloovium
one_liner: The company brain for construction companies
long_description: Alloovium is the document intelligence layer for construction 🏗️ It reads every document and piece of data on a project (contracts, specs, drawings, compliance records, conversations), turning them into answers you can trust and actions with real value: every answer cites its exact source sentence, paperwork is checked clause by clause against the builder's own Integrated Management System, and nothing AI-drafted moves without a human sign-off, with it all compliant by default.

name: MOCHI.TV
one_liner: 1 Minute Anime
long_description: Mochi is a mobile-first entertainment platform for vertical anime shorts. Users can scroll to discover shows and binge bite-sized episodes, unlocking them with either coins or a subscription. We produce new shows daily with AI, and they've hit 200M+ views organically across all platforms.

name: DeepReach Inc.
one_liner: Real-world data network for robots & world models
long_description:
Physical AI — robots and world models — is bottlenecked on one thing: diverse,
real-world data at massive scale showing how humans actually do work in the
physical world. It was never written down, and you can't buy it, because no one
has ever captured it. Only real local experts, the people who do this work every
day, can produce data this authentic and valuable.

DeepReach builds the network that reaches them. We design and manufacture
wearable stereo capture devices, then place them with local data partners who
run collection as their own business — in warehouses, workshops, farms, kitchens
and repair shops. They own the local relationships; we supply the hardware, the
software platform, the quality pipeline and the payments. Anyone can run a data
business.

That structure is what produces diversity. Instead of thousands of hours inside
one environment, we deliver hours spread across thousands of environments —
which is what actually makes robot policies generalize.

475 devices in the field and 100+ data partners are live across 7 countries, adding new
partners every week. They've collected nearly 150,000 clips in the past three
months, with volume roughly doubling month over month. Our data is in production
with multiple frontier model and robotics companies, and we're scaling to
10,000+ devices across 50 countries.

name: COACH
one_liner: The AI Coach for in person sales reps.
long_description:
Coach is the AI sales coach for in-person sales teams.

Reps record every meeting, and our AI figures out what your best closers do differently, then coaches everyone else to do the same, with precise, personalized feedback after every meeting. 

Managers finally see 100% of what happens in the field: Coach flags who's stuck and why, so they only step in when it matters, and can coach 5× more reps.

And every meeting feeds one sales brain, so leadership finally gets answers to the questions that used to be guesswork. They finally see the game of their team not just the scoreboard.

Our bet: in the AI era, in-person sales will only matter more. It may end up being one of the last truly human jobs.

Our conviction: any motivated rep can become a great one, meeting after meeting.

The results so far: +32% average lift in conversion rate.

COΛCH, post-game video analysis for field sales reps. YC S26

name: Grocalo

Grocalo generated 2B views and gained 4M followers for our creators in the last 2 months. Our clients include Jimmy O. Yang (Comedian, 11M followers), King Bach (72M followers), Leenda Dong (28M followers), Steven He (30M followers), Sheena Melwani (18M followers), and Jeannie Mai (TV host, 6M followers).

Content should be personalized and data-driven. We’re developing the most advanced AI brain capable of replicating virality for any given audience.

name: Audun

long_description: Audun automates debt collection.

name: Marble
one_liner: The autonomous back-of-house for restaurants.
long_description:
Marble is the first AI-native operating system for the restaurant back-of-house. 

Restaurants, cafes and bars still run on a patchwork of disconnected point solutions, spreadsheets, clipboards and tribal knowledge, which costs the industry billions each year in stockouts, food waste, and lost profit. 

Marble replaces that entire stack with one system. Computer vision and voice AI capture real-time inventory levels 90% faster than manual counts, ML models forecast item-level demand at 97% accuracy, and AI agents run dozens of end-to-end workflows autonomously, from procurement and invoice reconciliation to scheduling, food prep, menu engineering, and more.

name: Stoa
one_liner: The market behind AI hardware.
long_description: Stoa provides pricing and trading infrastructure for AI hardware, live with an RFQ marketplace where companies buy and sell GPUs through vetted dealers real-time.

name: Glen
one_liner: Institutional Learning Layer for Every Agent in Your Company
long_description:
Glen is the layer that unifies every agent your company runs. Glen pulls in agent sessions from Claude Code, Codex and Cursor, plus Slack messages, GitHub prs, tickets, docs and calls. When a new agent picks up a task, Glen finds relevant prior context and injects it in the agents context window to steer it, producing knowledge work that is significantly higher quality, faster and cheaper.

Glen does more. You can query the original agent behind any line of code, or search every session your org has ever run. It distills what your team does into skills and surfaces the right one automatically. Agents work multiplayer, picking up the style and context of whoever else is on the file. Transcripts are unified across Claude Code, Codex and Cursor, so you can hand a session from one to another mid-task. And Glen can also double as a company brain, from Slack, in app, or by just installing Glen on any agent.

We’re building toward a future where memory is no longer the missing piece of intelligence. A future where every agent maintains a lossless and continuous thread of institutional experience enabling the era of the compounding organization and fully unsupervised digital labour.

name: Context.dev
one_liner: We give AI agents realtime web context.
long_description:
Context.dev gives AI agents structured data from any website through a single API.

We help developers build smarter agents & products that depend on accurate, fresh web data.

If you need structured data from the internet, you need Context.dev

Proud to power agentic products at Mintlify, Super, Vizzy, Klarna, and 400+ other companies.

name: Codag

long_description:
Codag compresses tool call outputs before agents read them, which reduces token spend by  20-30% while retaining output accuracy.

Govern and see analytics on agent dollars across all model providers and internal agents.

name: Exosat
one_liner: Building a sovereign alternative to Starlink
long_description:
Exosat is building thousands of low-cost communication satellites to provide a neutral, sovereign alternative to Starlink. By designing our satellites with zero ITAR/EAR-controlled content, we can leverage manufacturers anywhere in the world to produce our satellites at under a tenth of the cost and launch them from other nations to bypass capacity bottlenecks and access equatorial orbits. 

We're starting off by selling connectivity to device OEMs and network operators, but will eventually use the distributed compute across our constellation to run low-latency inference for robots and autonomous vehicles in remote and rural areas anywhere on the planet.

We've already signed hundreds of millions in LOIs to work with operators across Central Asia, Southeast Asia, and the Middle East, booked our first satellite launch next year, and hold an 11,000 satellite filing with the ITU to build the largest comms network outside of the U.S. and China.

name: Prodigy Research

long_description: Prodigy is the frontier AI trading research lab. We've trained the world's best foundation model for quantitative finance. We've already achieved more than 100% returns in live trading over the course of our YC batch, doubling our capital while major indices were flat. Our founders previously worked at Jane Street, trained frontier AI models at Google DeepMind and shipped cutting-edge AI at Apple to billions of customers. Join us as we use AI to solve the market.

name: Zaplar
one_liner: Agentic Hotel Operating System
long_description:
Zaplar is the AI-native operating system for hotels.

Hotels run on legacy software and a fragmented tech stack. Zaplar replaces the entire hotel tech stack (PMS, POS, booking engine, etc) with one software that can handle hotel operations autonomously.

Learn more at https://zaplar.com

name: Spectre Intelligence
one_liner: We are a multi-strategy trading firm that trains AI traders.
long_description: Spectre Intelligence is a neotrading firm. We create AI traders instead of hiring human ones. Currently trading semis + bio.

name: screenpipe
one_liner: Turn your company's computer work into AI agents.
long_description: screenpipe record and learns how you work and turns it into a searchable memory, documents, and AI agents. Data is stored on your device or where your team choose, open source.

name: Manifold
one_liner: Deployment-ready robotic labor for the supply chain industry
long_description:
The US Warehouse industry spends $75bn on labor each year. Yet, only 10% of US warehouses have any form of automation, because existing robotics are too expensive and hard to integrate. 

Manifold deploys autonomous robots that handle picking, loading / unloading, and palletizing — priced by pick. Integration in hours. No upfront costs. No retrofitting. No need to rebuild the operation around the robot. 

Our mission is to make it easy for any warehouse to adopt robotics.

name: Rasyn
one_liner: Making chemicals 100,000x faster
long_description:
We builds foundational AI models for chemistry. Almost nothing you buy is a single chemical. Products like datacenter coolant, GPU thermal paste, paint, and glue are formulations, which are mixtures of around ten ingredients each, and demand for them has grown quickly because of AI and EVs.

Designing a new formulation is essentially a search problem, because there are more possible mixtures than anyone could ever test, and none of them can be predicted in advance. As a result, bringing a single formulation to market today takes three to five years of trial and error in a lab.

Our models predict how a mixture will behave far faster than the standard methods used today, which lets us design new formulations in weeks rather than years, at a fraction of the cost. To prove this, we used them to invent three chemicals that never existed before, including a PFAS-free coolant for datacenters, and we have since synthesized and patented all three.

We are already working with some of the largest manufacturers to design formulations for them, and we are building our own lab to generate the data that will train our next models.

name: Alkera AI
one_liner: Reliable and safe data engineering and data science agents
long_description: Alkera is a data engineering/analysis/science agent that works in your IDE or CLI. If you’re tired of agents that produce false, or even dangerous, reports about your data, then Alkera is for you. Our agent is equipped with your data’s history and lineage, your team’s knowledge, and tailored plugins for data apps such as Snowflake and dbt. Simply install and connect your services to begin doing trusted agentic data work. We also offer VPC & on-prem deployment options for when data can't leave your boundary.

name: Definite
one_liner: Build everyday back-office agents on one live model of your books
long_description:
Definite is where finance teams build everyday back-office agents on one live model of their books. We plug into your ERP, ledger, payroll, and payments read-only and compile everything into one clean model that stays current as money moves. Your back-office team then builds agents on top in plain English. We never write back and we never move money. The agents are yours, the plumbing is ours.

We met in first year computer science at Waterloo and interned at Meta, Optiver, and BitGo. At Optiver they ran an n8n hackathon and the interns automated basically nothing. It couldn't talk to the systems that mattered. When we pitched banks and fintechs on agents, they kept telling us the same thing. The agent isn't the hard part, getting clean data out of their systems is.

Right now, automating anything in a back office means engineers hand-stitching data from a dozen sources in different formats on different schedules. Tools like n8n and Workato assume your data is already clean and joined. In finance it never is. So the teams with the most repetitive work and smallest budgets get nothing.

The hard part is the compiler. Every source gets cleaned, matched, and joined into one live model of transactions, invoices, vendors, and payments, and it has to stay right as money lands every day. 

Everyone throws engineers at this. We're doing it once so nobody has to again. Every back office is getting agents eventually. Whoever owns the data they read from owns the thing all of them depend on, and eventually the books themselves. That's what we're building.

name: Callbook AI
one_liner: AI collections agency for late stage portfolios
long_description: Callbook AI is a collections agency operated by AI. We collect late stage portfolios by finding, contacting and negotiating with borrowers.

name: Tarifflo Inc.
one_liner: Supply chain compliance and cost savings
long_description:
Tarifflo is the infrastructure layer for modern customs - AI-powered filing, tariff recovery, and customs intelligence on one platform.

Filing should be free. Legacy ABI software charges you per entry, per user, per module. Brokers charge for every transaction. Tarifflo's filing software costs nothing - file directly with CBP under companies own filer codes.

We make money when our clients do. 1 in 8 entries has an error that overpays duty - misclassification, tariff stacking, valuation, origin. Most importers never catch them. Our AI audits your entries, finds the overpayments, and helps file for your refund. 

Under both is the same engine, live tariff intelligence covering every HTS code, Chapter 99 program, exclusion, and rate change - so the duty you pay going forward is as right as the refunds we recover looking back.

name: Veltha
one_liner: AI native TPA starting with workers comp
long_description:
Veltha is the AI native TPA starting with workers comp. We handle claim for insurance providers end to end.

Learn more at https://veltha.ai

name: Traceforce
one_liner: Securing AI native apps directly on devices
long_description:
AI apps such as ChatGPT and Claude have become part of everyone's daily workflow, but they introduce new security risks that traditional security tools weren't built to handle. Security teams at companies from startups to Fortune 500s, are struggling to keep up.

Traceforce gives a company’s security team visibility of how AI apps are being used across company’s devices, and the ability to detect and prevent security breaches and unsafe actions as early as possible.

name: EdotEnv
one_liner: A Quant Neolab building self-improving agents from quant trading
long_description:
A Quant Neolab building toward RSI by leveraging markets as self-improving research environments.

They work with frontier AI labs and academic groups building research harnesses, evaluation benchmarks, and post-training environments.

name: Standard Machines
one_liner: Teaching AI to Design Chips
long_description: We build environments and evaluations to train and evaluate models on advanced chip design.

name: Agency Tool Company
one_liner: Reliable infrastructure to build, deploy and manage real-world robots.
long_description:
Agency Tool Company ships software to robots in the field 20x faster than a Docker pull with ATC Deploy, sending only the bytes that changed and resuming when the network drops. Deployment tooling is the connection between the lab & the field that continually bottlenecks robotics scaling and lacks a strong robotics-native solution. Deploy is live today with 3 launch partners across ag, construction, and logistics robotics.

Our second product, ATC Build, offers embedded-compute as a CI service so devs can run tests and validate their software on the actual target hardware. Build supports the Nvidia Jetson lineup, Raspberry Pi, and a number of other embedded platform targets.

Jack Morrison and Davis Foster founded and sold Scythe Robotics after deploying hundreds of autonomous mowers across the country; Agency Tool Company is building the robotics deployment platform across hardware and software they wish they had.

Learn more at https://agencytool.com

name: Cerenovus
one_liner: AI that finds value creation opportunities across enterprise…
long_description: We are building an AI operating partner that reads every record a company produces to find and prioritize value creation opportunities, including costly operational inefficiencies no one is tracking. Cerenovus warns leaders before small problems become expensive and turns weeks of manual investigation into evidence-backed answers in minutes. Every claim links to its source, and every finding is ranked by impact. Companies use it to improve their operations; private equity and advisory firms deploy it across the businesses they own or advise.

name: Molagri
one_liner: Resistance free pesticides.
long_description:
Molagri develops safer, more effective pesticides for agriculture.

We design biopesticides that hit a precise molecular target unique to pest insects, knocking out pests while sparing pollinators, beneficial insects, and the wider ecosystem. By modeling how pests are likely to evolve, we stay a step ahead of resistance, keeping our products effective against the pests of today and tomorrow. The higher efficacy and biobased production will also contribute to emissions reductions in both manufacturing and field use.

Our founders are PhD lab mates from the University of Toronto who have worked together for six years and published in Nature Communications and Nature Microbiology.

name: Peer
one_liner: AI-native freight brokerage
long_description: Peer is building an AI-native freight brokerage that quotes freight, finds the right trucking companies, tracks shipments, and handles problems from pickup through delivery for shippers.

name: Stratum Industries
one_liner: Applied AI for Governments.
long_description:
Stratum Industries is the applied AI company for governments. We build AI agents that automate the slow, complex manual workflows governments run on, starting with application review, where files are still reviewed by hand, one at a time, leaving millions stuck in queues. 

Stratum's agents review applications end to end with a human in the loop and full auditability, clearing entire backlogs in a fraction of the time. Our mission is to deploy AI across every vertical inside the government, saving agencies tens of billions in administrative cost and making the government one of the most efficient institutions in the world.

name: FlowManual
one_liner: AI for Construction's Back Office
long_description:
FlowManual is the all-in-one AI estimating, bidding, and purchasing platform for both general and MEP construction contractors.

Built by two engineers and Harvard dropouts, FlowManual automates the buying process during pre-construction. With FlowManual, specialty contractors win more work while general contractors deliver at higher standards.

name: Pluto
one_liner: Voice agent that learns about professionals and makes them searchable
long_description:
Resumes made careers readable. LinkedIn made them filterable. Pluto makes them searchable.

Professionals spend 10 minutes talking to Pluto's voice agent about what they've done, what they're great at, and what they want next. Pluto turns that into a structured picture of who someone actually is, capturing the competency and intent that resumes and LinkedIn don't.

When companies and AI agents go looking to hire, Pluto makes the right people discoverable.

25K+ professionals have shared their career context with Pluto, and 50+ companies, including Mercor, Warp, and Rho, use it to find and reach the right people. Long-term, we're building the LinkedIn for agents.

name: machine0
one_liner: Cloud computers for AI agents
long_description:
machine0 is a CLI for agent compute: `machine0 new mybox` gives your agent a full cloud VM, billed by the minute, from small up to 60 vCPU / 240 GB and 8×H100s. Agents drive it themselves via CLI or MCP.

Agent workloads are moving from ephemeral to always-on. A coding agent working on a hard feature runs 6-8 hours. Auto-research agents run for days. machine0 is the environment in which these agents run.

name: Bloomy

one_liner: Nervous System for Physical AI

name: Nori

long_description:
We manufacture Nori: A sub-$2000 bimanual mobile manipulator that can clean rooms, restock shelves, and fold clothes. Nori can handle basic tasks out of the box, and its software lets anyone teach Nori to automate work specific to their home or business. 

Nori aims to solve the robotics data bottleneck. By deploying affordable robots to customers around the world, we can gather the diverse data required to train the next generation of generalist robotic policies. Every user of Nori makes Nori smarter.

Since launching 6 weeks ago we have already deployed our first robot and have over $350k+ in sales.

We can bring general-purpose robotics to homes and businesses that could never afford it before. There are 132.7 million households and 8.4 million employer business locations in the U.S. At $1,688 per robot, selling just one Nori to 0.5% of them represents a $1.2B market opportunity in the U.S. alone.

name: Ooak Data
one_liner: We turn company data into training data
long_description: Ooak Data turns internal company data into a training ground where AI agents can be tested on real work.

name: Graphify Labs
one_liner: On-device knowledge graph engine for enterprises
long_description:
Graphify builds a queryable knowledge graph from your codebase, docs, and Jira. The open-source engine has 105K+ GitHub stars and ~5M downloads, and is used in production by engineers at Rootly, Geotab, Tweddle Group, and Superagent.

On top of that graph, our enterprise layer reviews every pull request and formally verifies each code change: it proves the new behavior matches the old, or hands back the exact input that breaks it. That makes it built for the changes teams fear most, like refactors, framework upgrades, and large-scale code migrations, where you need proof that nothing broke, not a guess.

The graph updates itself as the code changes and keeps context instead of forgetting it, so your whole team and their coding agents work from one shared, always-current view of the codebase instead of a thousand private threads.

It runs entirely inside your perimeter, fully air-gapped on-premise or self-hosted in your own cloud, so no code or data ever leaves your environment.

name: Aerogen Systems
one_liner: Building the future of advanced chip manufacturing.
long_description:
We are building the future of chip manufacturing.

Chips are more advanced than ever, and the features inside them keep getting smaller. But the cleanroom infrastructure supporting their manufacture has not scaled at the same pace. Intel, TSMC, Samsung, and others spend billions building and operating massive cleanrooms, only to isolate their most advanced wafers from the surrounding facility as much as possible.

We think that architecture is backwards. Instead of making the entire building cleaner, why not make the machinery itself as clean as possible?

Talos is our proprietary tool-integrated purification system. It sits directly inside semiconductor equipment and continuously destroys airborne molecular contaminants before they reach the wafer. Instead of fighting contamination by constantly flooding tools with ultra-high-purity nitrogen, Talos keeps the environment inside the machine 10–100x cleaner, without the massive purge-gas bill.

Talos is powerful on its own, but it is also the foundation for a much bigger vision: the Cleanpipe.

The Aerogen Systems Cleanpipe is an ultra-clean interconnect infrastructure that protects wafers as they move from machine to machine across the fab. Rather than relying on a billion-dollar cleanroom to protect every cubic foot of factory space, Cleanpipe creates a controlled environment only where cleanliness actually matters: around the wafer.

Talos cleans the tools. Cleanpipe connects them. Eventually, we delete the cleanroom and build more advanced chips, at greater scale, with radically less infrastructure. With cleanpipes connecting tools, chip fabs can exist anywhere.

name: Hilstart
one_liner: Autonomous Hardware Testing
long_description: We build physical agent harnesses to enable AI to debug, validate, and ship functional hardware and software.

name: Greypoint Industries
one_liner: Building drone swarms that hunt drone operators
long_description: We build LEGION, a drone swarm that identifies, geolocates, and tracks every emitter on the battlefield using the enemy’s own radio signals. LEGION enables our warfighters to precisely track previously obscured targets like jammers, command posts, and drone operators so they can proactively respond to threats instead of reacting to them.

name: TareBio
one_liner: Vaccines for any cancer or infection in weeks.
long_description: Our platform develops personalized or population-level vaccines for any disease in weeks by changing only one input: the immune imprint. Instead of trying to predict which antigens might work, we read out immune cells already fighting the disease in the body and reverse-engineer antigens that activate them. We've already run our platform end-to-end and created a vaccine that cured cancer in mice.

name: Almanac
one_liner: The AI that knows you
long_description: Almanac is the agent that knows you. You message it in Slack or iMessage; it knows what is happening across your company and can use your accounts to get real tasks done for you. It has a full computer, browser and terminal. It takes your Gmail, Calendar, Attio, GitHub, AI convos, docs and meeting notes and compiles them into a Wiki that keeps itself up to date. It keeps a current understanding of what you’re building, who your customers are, what was decided, and what still needs to happen. It can use websites, run code, create files and take actions across your accounts. If it reaches a login, payment or decision it shouldn’t make alone, it pings you or hands you the live browser.

name: Whitespace

name: Vendo

long_description:

name: Aktoria Robotics
